method: episodic REINFORCE over a squashed Gaussian distribution of conditional controller parameters
actor: The same44 causal features,4 by44 weights in[-1,1], fixed arm basis and native-noise steering runtime as the minimum pilot

defaults_not_physically_tuned.baseline: Mean return of the other three samples; no privileged reward input
defaults_not_physically_tuned.shared_initialization: Accept exactly four bounded controllers with two valid case scores each; initialize at the best by score sum, then stable identifier
defaults_not_physically_tuned.mean_controller: tanh(center), with the original LatentController execution semantics

checkpoint: RNG, center, fixed configuration, shared data, pending raw draws, weights and hashes, partial scores and completed update history
cost_contract: The caller must account for shared initialization once globally and every new full, partial or failed attempt in a prospective physical queue. Stored valid scores do not replace an interaction ledger.
requires_before_physical_use: A new authorized complete learning arm and independent audit within an explicit interaction and time budget
Matched observations, action domain, shared initialization, tuning allowance and task/seed cases
Prospectively frozen learning hyperparameters and finalist rule
Full native episode and causal/source verification before recording scores
scope: A tested interface, not learning efficacy, evolutionary superiority or a competent state-conditioned latent SAC baseline. It is excluded from the frozen minimum EA/random-search pilot.
